title: update

goal.text: Refresh the published claw-kit CLI and update the Cindy plugin from its custom Git marketplace.

requirements.summary: Refresh the global CLI first, refresh Cindy through the claw-kit custom Git marketplace second, then verify both installed surfaces and report exact status.
acceptanceCriteria: The published global `@veewo/claw` CLI and Cindy plugin are both refreshed.
The Cindy source is the unpinned `chanyuenpang/claw-kit` custom marketplace and its `claw-kit-cindy` entry.
The marketplace manifest, installed plugin id, enabled state, and runtime state are verified against the target version.
The result reports exact success or failure for each surface.

tasks.title: Confirm the published target version and Cindy marketplace source
tasks.detail: Tell the user a newer claw-kit version was detected. Confirm Cindy has or can add the unpinned Git source `chanyuenpang/claw-kit`, refresh it, and verify marketplace entry `claw-kit-cindy` resolves plugin id `claw-kit` from `packages/cindy-adapter/plugin`. Read the candidate version from that source's `ghost.json`. A release workflow must push and tag the source before installation refresh.

tasks.title: Refresh the CLI and Cindy plugin
tasks.detail: Refresh the global CLI first from its published package. Refresh the `chanyuenpang/claw-kit` custom market, review any permission expansion, and accept Cindy's install/update confirmation for plugin id `claw-kit`. If a legacy manual install conflicts, permit exact-manifest adoption only; otherwise uninstall it and perform one marketplace install. Do not download or open a `.cindy` archive.

default.summary: The CLI and Cindy plugin refresh commands completed; verify both installed surfaces.
nextsteps: Verify the marketplace source, enabled plugin identity, and matching manifests.

tasks.title: Verify the CLI and Cindy plugin
tasks.detail: Run `claw --version` and `npm list -g @veewo/claw --depth=0`. Record the marketplace Git revision and candidate `ghost.json` version. Verify the installed Cindy plugin id `claw-kit` is enabled and running at the same version. Restart Cindy and start a new task before validating the loaded skill version. Report exact success or failure for both surfaces.

references.why: Preserves the direct Cindy update workflow when the claw template cannot run.
Maps Cindy update requirements to this skill package.

rules: Do not route or ask about another host; this is the Cindy update workflow.
Publish and verify the target version before release-time installation refresh.
Use only the unpinned `chanyuenpang/claw-kit` custom marketplace and the installed plugin id `claw-kit`.
Do not claim success unless both CLI and Cindy plugin verification pass.
